name: TRMNL for PaperDIY (community port)
description: TRMNL e-ink dashboard firmware for the M5Stack PaperDIY (K159): shows screens from TRMNL's cloud or a self-hosted server (BYOS, e.g. LaraPaper). On battery it switches itself off through the M5PM1 between refreshes. Not for PaperS3.
keywords: TRMNL, dashboard, e-ink, BYOS, LaraPaper, PaperDIY, M5Stack
author: dcarnicer
